title: Mandate 86: agents clean up finished worktrees
goal: Vision: V-11. CEO directive 2026-11-16: agents must clean up finished worktrees. Record CEO Mandate 86 in core (constitution entry, docs/ceo-mandate-86.md, AGENTS.md, CLAUDE.md and GEMINI.md, README, self-build contract with no net line in core under Mandate 84) and guard it in the governance tests. The workflow tool that removes them is in intellibitz/susi-commercial-apps (its T-AGENTCLAUDECLAIMDONE-2).
limitations: Core carries the rule, its documents, the self-build clause and the governance tests; the cleanup itself is the commercial workflow tool's.
The self-build clause was added with no net line in core (Mandate 84): 'in the task record' was dropped from the reuse clause to make room.

reuse.searched: Mandates 77, 83 and 85 and their records, the self-build contract, the governance guards, and the workflow tool's worktree prune and its new idle reclaim in intellibitz/susi-commercial-apps (T-AGENTCLAUDECLAIMDONE-2 there). Documentation and governance tests only in core.
